seoDescription: Find LCPS 2027–28 first days by grade, school breaks, remote-learning dates, last days, graduation times, and official English and Spanish calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Las Cruces Public Schools begins 2027–28 with a transition day for kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade on Friday, July 23, 2027. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 begin Monday, July 26. Fall Break is October 4–8, Winter Break is December 20–31, and Spring Break is March 13–17. K, 6, and 9 finish May 18; grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11 finish May 19.
calendarNotes: LCPS does not have one first day or last day for every student. Kindergarten, grade 6, and grade 9 begin July 23 and finish May 18; grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11 begin July 26 and finish May 19. Seniors follow graduation and campus instructions. Educator Planning dates include remote learning activities, while August 27 and February 18 are no-school conference and planning dates. Cultural Awareness Week is an observance while school remains in session. LCPS publishes the main 2027–28 calendar in English and Spanish.

customSections.label: Source Note: Post-Year Memorial Day Label
customSections.content: The official LCPS PDF labels May 22, 2028, as Memorial Day, while the U.S. Office of Personnel Management lists Memorial Day on Monday, May 29. Regular student schedules end by May 19 and graduations conclude May 20, so this page flags the discrepancy without treating May 22 as a student closure. Families or staff with post-year obligations should confirm the date with LCPS.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all LCPS students start on the same day in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade start Friday, July 23, 2027. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–12 start Monday, July 26.

calendarFaqs.q: Are LCPS Educator Planning days days off?
calendarFaqs.a: Not ordinary days off. LCPS labels August 26, October 11, February 17, and April 17 as Educator Planning dates with remote learning activities.

calendarFaqs.q: When do LCPS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3–4 are staff days, and K–12 students begin the spring semester January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for each LCPS grade group?
calendarFaqs.a: Kindergarten, sixth grade, and ninth grade finish May 18. Grades 1–5, 7–8, and 10–11 finish May 19. Seniors should follow their high school's graduation instructions.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the LCPS 2027–28 calendar available in Spanish?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. LCPS publishes an official Spanish 2027–28 instructional calendar linked on this page.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 11, 2026, against the official LCPS calendar page and the one-page English instructional calendar revised July 27, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: The main calendar was checked visually because color coding and compact grade labels can be lost or flattened during text extraction.
The printed totals are 183 student days and 190 teacher days.
Both first and last instructional dates were recorded by grade group instead of collapsing the transition schedule into one districtwide date.
Educator Planning dates are listed as remote-learning days. August 27 and February 18 are listed separately as no-school days.
Cultural Awareness Week is listed as an in-session observance because the official calendar says school remains in session.

The PDF's May 22 Memorial Day label conflicts with OPM's May 29, 2028 federal holiday schedule. Because the label follows the last student day and graduation weekend, this page discloses the discrepancy without treating May 22 as a student closure.
The source PDF says it was approved by the LCPS Board on February 18, 2025, and revised July 27, 2026.
